programs.title: Formula 1 Racing
programs.desc: The Formula One grid races the Monaco Grand Prix. Monégasque driver Charles Leclerc finally changed his luck at his home race in 2024, winning in his fifth attempt in a Ferrari. Max Verstappen earned his second victory of the season May 18 in Italy.

programs.title: Formula 1
programs.desc: The Formula 1 Channel provides 24/7 coverage for racing enthusiasts, specializing in full race replays, classic Grand Prix archives, and expert analysis from F1, F2, F3, and F1 Academy, alongside deep-dive documentaries and technical features.
